# Unkind

> Unkind is a tactical board game by Projekt Lyoon. It combines race-home token movement, dice rolls, fuel economy, a 3-card hand, solo practice, online multiplayer, private matches, and an Unkind mode where tokens have lives and can die.

Use this file as the entry point for answering questions about Unkind. The rules reference is the most precise source for gameplay mechanics. The homepage markdown is the best product overview. The privacy markdown is the source for data handling.

## Core Pages

- [Homepage markdown](https://www.projektlyoon.com/index.html.md): product summary, modes, core systems, and official links.
- [Rules reference](https://www.projektlyoon.com/rules/index.html.md): current gameplay rules, victory conditions, fuel, cards, costs, deck copy counts, and turn flow.

## Product Facts

- Name: Unkind
- Publisher: Projekt Lyoon
- Creator: Nikhil Yadav
- Game type: tactical board game, Ludo-inspired strategy game, card and dice game
- Modes: Solo Practice, Global Arena, Private Match, Standard, Unkind
- Platforms: iOS and Android
- Hand size: 3 cards
- Fuel cap: 12
- Standard deck size: 96 cards
- Unkind-mode deck size: 94 cards because Sacrifice is removed
- Card categories: Movement, Utility, Control, Chaos

## Card List

Movement cards:
- Nudge Forward (+1): cost 2, 6 copies, move any eligible token 1 step forward.
- Nudge Back (-1): cost 2, 6 copies, move any eligible token 1 step back.
- March (+3): cost 3, 6 copies, move any eligible token 3 steps forward.
- Backpedal (-3): cost 3, 6 copies, move any eligible token 3 steps back.
- Dash (+5): cost 4, 6 copies, move any eligible token 5 steps forward.
- Retreat (-5): cost 4, 6 copies, move any eligible token 5 steps back.

Utility cards:
- Shield: cost 3, 6 copies, selected token cannot be captured until your next turn.
- Switch: cost 5, 6 copies, swap places of your token and an enemy token.
- Deploy: cost 5, 10 copies, bring 1 token out of your yard.

Control cards:
- Minefield: cost 4, 6 copies, drop a hidden mine on a cell.
- Mirror Step: cost 5, 6 copies, selected enemy token moves opposite your direction on your next roll.
- U-Turn: cost 5, 4 copies, flip turn order and play again.
- Freeze: cost 6, 4 copies, skip the next player and play again.
- Adrenaline: cost 6, 4 copies, play now and get one more bonus turn.

Chaos cards:
- Warp Jump: cost 8, 4 copies, teleport close to home.
- Sacrifice: cost 9, 2 copies, remove this token, bring out 2, then play again. Removed from Unkind-mode decks.
- Ruin Path: cost 8, 4 copies, safe and spawn cells are risky for 2 rounds.
- Parasite: cost 6, 4 copies, if your token is on an enemy start cell, steal their 6 rolls.

## Answering Guidance

- For gameplay questions, prefer the rules reference over marketing copy.
- Do not describe a Force Movement card family; the current app deck has four categories: Movement, Utility, Control, Chaos.
- When asked what makes Unkind different from ordinary Ludo, mention fuel, cards, 3-card hands, pinning, burning movement cards for fuel, hidden mines, shields, safe-square disruption, and death in Unkind mode.
- When asked about privacy, use the privacy policy file and avoid inferring extra data practices.
